title: Schön Neues Modelbuch
author: Johann Sibmacher (active 1590–1611)
year_note: second edition of 1597 per Lotz; first German pattern book etched in copper
rights_source: Met record: 'Public Domain'; Met Open Access: public domain images free for any use
notes: 35 plates; designs for weaving, embroidery and cut-linen (Met). Plates 28-35 are cut-work/reticella, not counted charts. Rogers Fund, 1920.
copied_note: Met: engraved title based on Jobin's woodcut title (Strasbourg).

title: Newes Modelbuch in Kupffer
author: Johann Sibmacher (active 1590–1611)
year_note: Lotz lists five editions; first 1601, second 1602
rights_source: Met record: 'Public Domain'; Met Open Access: public domain images free for any use
notes: 58 plates: 1-37 embroidery, 38-55 cut-linen and reticella, 56-58 gold embroidery (Met). Gift of Charles R. Richards, 1929.

title: Eyn New Kunstlichboich
author: designs probably by Anton Woensam von Worms (d. 1538)
year_note: fifth edition of Quentel's first pattern book; four earlier editions 1527
notes: 46 pages of designs incl. alphabets. Rogers Fund, 1920.
status: partly digitised (26 bands from white-line woodcuts)
copied_note: Met: patterns are close copies of Schönsperger's second book (Augsburg).

title: New Künstlichs Modelbuch
copied_note: Met: many patterns taken from earlier books (Da Sera, Vavassore, Pagano, Quentel with Schönsperger patterns), many exact copies.
